text:
nina (partnerships): FYI we've got a new asset drop from CloudLattice for the marketplace tile + one-pager. Need quick logo QA and a 15-word blurb. ETA: 48h.

assetbot (system): Uploaded: CloudLattice_CoBrand_Pack_1.zip to /partnerships/cloudlattice/2490012345 sha256: a1b2c3d4.

ben (design): Opening now. initial: they provided full-color svg and a mono png. their lockup wants 16px clearspace at 72dpi. reversed white works on our navy but their purple (#5E2DB2) is close to our accent — recommend slight tint shift so both logos read.

zoe (marketing): Draft blurb: "CloudLattice + Redwood streamline model serving across multi-cloud and edge." can we tighten to 15 words?

ben (design): Shorten layout note: use 48px min width on tiles, add 8% padding. I'll export SVG/PNG for 300/600 sizes and drop into drive.

marc (legal): Confirm CloudLattice granted marketplace + collateral usage? Also need trademark statement: "CloudLattice is a trademark of CloudLattice, Inc." Nina, please attach clause. If we edit color slightly, get explicit written approval.

nina (partnerships): Contract clause 3.4 covers marketplace use. I'll ask for color tweak approval and sign-off on quote edits.

zoe (marketing): Final 15-word blurb suggestion: "CloudLattice and Redwood accelerate multi-cloud and edge inference with consistent latency and simplified ops." thumbs?

ben (design): thumbs. I'll deliver assets by tomorrow morning with alt text and recommended captions.

marc (legal): thumbs once we have written permission for the tint change.

nina (partnerships): I'll request permission now and share the checklist. thanks team :)
